title: : YOU MUSTN’T FORGET GOD!
body: : YOU MUSTN’T FORGET GOD! “. let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price” (KJV) 1 Pet 3:4 The word meek as used above is from Greek praus meaning mild. God wants us to be yielded, teachable, receptive and unassuming. But then, God must first and foremost tame and train us! He tames and trains only the meek - not those who are full of themselves. Quietly ponder on this verse, “The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way” (KJV) Ps 25:9. The Bible places value on meekness. Meekness brings man to a realm of blessedness. “Blessed (happy, lithesome, joyous, spiritually prosperous - with lifejoy and satisfaction in God's favor and salvation, regardless of their outward conditions) are the meek (the mild, patient, long-suffering), for they shall inherit the earth!” (Amp) Matt 5:5. Without Christ, there is no meekness; it’s just pretense.
prayer: Dear Lord, help me to submit my will both to be trained and tamed by Your Spirit divine. Cause me to be an embodiment of true meekness in all my ways in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : THE ORNAMENT OF MEEKNESS
verse: “The LORD by wisdom founded the earth.” (RSV)
body: : THE ORNAMENT OF MEEKNESS “The LORD by wisdom founded the earth.” (RSV) Pro 3:19 You can't go on well in life until you let go of your past mistakes and heartaches. True wisdom is in letting go and letting God - have His way in your way. It has been said, “The happiest of people don't necessarily have the best of everything; they just make the most of everything that comes along their way.” You can be filled with the Spirit of wisdom. “And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship, To devise cunning works.” (KJV) Exo 31:3-5. Here is the wisdom: Let go every anger for it is an act of foolishness, “Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools” (KJV) Ecc 7:9. Keep away from bitterness, it limits, “Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled” (KJV) Heb 12:15. keep covetousness away, it is the root of all evils, 1 Tim 6:10.
prayer: Father, by Your divine grace, anger, bitterness, covetousness and the like shall not have a grip over my life in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : WISDOM FOR LIVING
body: : WISDOM FOR LIVING “Seek out of the book of the Lord and read: not one of these [details of prophecy] shall fail, none shall want and lack her mate [in fulfillment]. For the mouth [of the Lord] has commanded, and His Spirit has gathered them” (Amp) Isa 34:16 The Word of God carries immeasurable power - the world was created by it, Jesus’ wonders were anchored on it, disciples wrought notable miracles by it, great investors and achievers rose by it. And so, your future is determined by it. The Word does not just work - you have a part to play - for the Word to work for you. Except you play your part, the Word remains a mirage without experiencing its miracle, Ps 1:1-3. Your due season of fruitfulness and ever flourishing life are tied to your delight of the Word. The more of His Word you imbibe, the more triumphant you become. The greater the trust you have in the Word, the bigger your worth. Don’t let anything else determine your worth. Let only the Word of God be a major determinant. Relate with the Word. Speak only what the Word speaks, John 15:7.
prayer: Dear Lord, I ask that You help me to be a diligent seeker of Your Word and to always live by the standard of Your Word in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : THE WORD DETERMINES YOUR WOR TH
verse: is he that giveth thee power to get wealth.” (KJV)
body: : THE WORD DETERMINES YOUR WOR TH “But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth.” (KJV) Deut 8:18 God is happy seeing things happening for you. “. Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant” (KJV) Ps 35:27. He takes pleasure in your prosperity! If Jesus Christ is the Saviour and the Lord of your life, then you have no business with wretchedness. At conversion, you have the power to become [John 1:12]. One of the purposes of this power is to get wealth and create limitless opportunities. Tap into the power within. Get yourself connected, “But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding” (KJV) Job 32:8. Passionately, with a deep sense of purpose, delight yourself in God, “Delight thyself also in Jehovah; And he will give thee the desires of thy heart” (ASV) Ps 37:4. Be continually thankful for where God is taking you to. Thank Him for who He is. Thank Him for His power that is immeasurable. Thank Him for prosperity He is handling over to you even when you don’t look like it, Ps 22:3.
prayer: I receive power to make wealth, Amen.

title: : POWER TO GET WEAL TH
verse: the watchman waketh but in vain” (KJV) Ps 127:1
body: : POWER TO GET WEAL TH “Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain” (KJV) Ps 127:1 “See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant” (KJV) Jer 1:10. Prayer places and positions man in contact with the Almighty God, the result of prayer is the almightiness of God at work. God has entrusted us with a force that can move the heavenly forces into action, and bring God’s power to display on earth. Until you create time to be alone with God you’re not set for the supernatural turn around. “And Jacob was left alone. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.” (KJV) Gen 32:24-28. You must prevail - with God and men on your knees - to command heaven’s attention. Be a pray-er! Be a prevail-er! Prevailing is not about the length of prayer in some cases; it is about its intensity and the power it carries. God does nothing but in response to our prayer. Learn the skills of praying all kinds of prayers for with the arm of flesh shall no man prevail.
confession: Spend quality time to pray through.

title: : PUSH. NOT IN THE ARM OF FLESH
body: : PUSH. NOT IN THE ARM OF FLESH “Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes.” (KJV) Pro 20:13 “All achievements, all earned riches, have their beginning in an idea” said Napoleon Hill. Succeeding with ideas are not difficult, “Take up one idea. Make that one idea your life. Think of it, dream of it, live on that idea. Let the brain, muscles, nerves, every part of your body, be full of that idea, and just leave every other idea alone. This is the way to success. That is way great spiritual giants are produced.” Voltaire said, “I have no more than twenty acres of ground, the whole of which I cultivate myself with the help of my children; and our labor keeps off from us the three great evils - boredom, vice, and want.” There are one thousand and one wealth creation ideas that are capable of launching you into multi millions. Lydia made it through the selling of purple [Acts 16:14-15]. Aquila and Priscilla [Acts 18:2-3] made it by tent making. Joses made it through landed property [Acts 4:36-37]. You can create wealth by selling, rendering services, production or estate management and properties.
prayer: I receive an uncommon idea right now [ Remain in His presence. Let God speak to you].

title: : BIBLICAL WEAL TH CREA TION IDEAS
body: : BIBLICAL WEAL TH CREA TION IDEAS “But. all. covetousness, let it not be once named among you.” (KJV) Eph 5:3 The best side of life comes from godliness with contentment. “But those who have a desire for wealth are falling into danger, and are taken as in a net by a number of foolish and damaging desires. For the love of money is a root of all evil.” (BBE) 1 Tim 6:9-10. Here are people who lost their place to covetousness. Eve desired the forbidden fruit [Gen 3:6], Lot chose the plain of the Jordan [Gen 13:10-13], Balaam loved the wages of unrighteousness [2 Pet 2:15; Num 22], Achan hid the treasure [Jos 7:21], Gehazi took a gift from Namaan [2 Kings 5:20-27], Judas betrayed Jesus [Matt 26:15; Luke 22:3-6] and Demas loved the world [2 Tim 4:10]. Money, property, high-paying jobs, fame and popularity, prestige are among other things most people look at as a gauge of success or as insurance for a secure future. Though nothing is wrong with all of these, but we must guard our life and heart and see to it that we do not loose our soul in pursuit of them, Luke 12:15.
prayer: Almighty God, I renounce and reject the spirit of covetousness in any form. Covetousness shall not rule over my life in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : WARNING AGAINST COVET OUSNESS
body: : WARNING AGAINST COVET OUSNESS

title: : COVENANT OF BLESSINGS
body: : COVENANT OF BLESSINGS “And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing” (KJV) Gen 12:2 All over the world, there are billions who claim Abraham as their ancestor. Millions of Jews acknowledge Abraham as their father, and so do millions of Arabs. Millions of latter-day Saints hold him as their forefather, while billions of Christians world-wide consider Abraham to be their father. Why this claim? Covenant blessings are the reasons. God told Abraham, “That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed. thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies” (KJV) Gen 22:17. You can lay claim on it. “Blessed shalt thou be in the city. Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body. Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out” (KJV) Deut 28:3-6; Deut 28:12. CONFESSION: The God of my Father shall help me; and the Almighty shall bless me with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb. My blessings shall prevail above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills. [Spend time to pray through]. “. ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves” (KJV) Isa 61:6 Our text reveals a prophetic, supernatural wealth transfer into the hands of God’s children - the rightful owners. “Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings.” (KJV) Isa 60:16; 49:23. Abraham partook of this supernatural wealth transfer in Egypt [Gen 12:1416, 13:1-2]. Joseph got the wealth of the then superpower Nation - Egypt. He got it for a possession [Gen 41:39-44]. The children of Israel, by supernatural arrangement, went with the wealth of Egypt - they enjoyed true miracle of transfer [Exo 3:19-22]. Solomon enjoyed the wealth of nations. He exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches [1 Kings 10:23]. There are thousands of people around the world who’re partaking of this grace. I prophesy your miracle of supernatural wealth transfer this very month.
confession: I decree that earthly systems and laws, from today, shall favour me in-line with heaven’s order of supernatural wealth transfer. It’s my season for the miracle of wealth transfer. [Spend quality time in praying through to your breakthrough - Do send us your testimony].

title: : SUPERNA TURAL WEAL TH TRANSFER
verse: as. loss for Christ's sake” (AMP) Phil 3:7
body: : SUPERNA TURAL WEAL TH TRANSFER “But whatever former things I had that might have been gains to me, I have come to consider as. loss for Christ's sake” (AMP) Phil 3:7 A time came in history, in line with God's plan – God’s manifold grace touched Paul’s heart - and made him a new being. He told of it in Romans 7. When a man is truly saved, salvation brings about a turning point that brings about a real transformation of character - He wears a new look, put on a new thinking pattern. He now counts all things loss for Christ’s excellence. “Yes, furthermore, I count everything as loss compared to the possession of the priceless privilege (the overwhelming preciousness, the surpassing worth, and supreme advantage). in order that I may win (gain) Christ (the Anointed One)” (Amp) Phil 3:8. If you say you love the Lord, do His Words abide in you? If you say your sins are forgiven, prove it by the life you live, Jer 9:23-24.
confession: All to Jesus I surrender; All to Him I freely give; I’ll ever love and trust Him, In His presence daily live. I surrender all; All to Thee, my blessed Savior, All to Jesus I surrender; Humbly at His feet I bow, Worldly pleasures all forsaken; Take me, Jesus, take me now.

title: : COUNTED LOSS FOR CHRIST
body: : COUNTED LOSS FOR CHRIST “Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors.” (KJV) Ps 24:7 Satanic embargoes are spiritual limitations and blockages. Satanic embargoes could come as a result of ancestral and personal sins [Neh 9:33-35], speaking evil or lies against innocent people [Neh 9:26], willfully commission of damaging sins [abortion, shedding of innocent blood etc], seeking protection from outside the living God among others. Some of the indices of embargoes are: spiritual and physical enslavement, working for another to reap, prolong illness that defies medical solutions, oppression and the like. Breaking of satanic embargoes is that simple - confess your sins and that of your ancestors [1 John 1:9]. Exercise your spiritual authority [Rev 12:11; Matt 11:12]. Enter into a covenant with God, 2 Chro 34:31. In warfare prayer, deal with all spiritually forces. Read: Col 2:15; Isa 49:24-24.
prayer: Read Isa 10:27 and Gal 5:10b 1. Confess your sins if any 2. Reject evil debts of your ancestors and free yourself from them 3. Break every stronghold of satan over your life and family 4. Reverse every satanic plan and establish your total freedom in Christ.

title: : DEALING WITH EMBARGOES
body: : DEALING WITH EMBARGOES “Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn.” (KJV) Neh 5:3 We sometimes need to borrow to achieve some specific plans and lofty feats. Borrowing must be for a need, not a want; it must be for an asset and not what leads to liability. “The beginning of Wisdom is: get Wisdom (skillful and godly Wisdom)! [For skillful and godly Wisdom is the principal thing.] And with all you have gotten, get understanding (discernment, comprehension, and interpretation)” (Amp) Pro 4:7. To avoid debt trap, avoid such loans that will leave little or no money in your account at the end of the month and avoid borrowing from different sources to pay off your dues. The next two verses of our text reads, “There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king's tribute.” If you will not go ‘a sorrowing’ stop going ‘a borrowing’. Live within the limit of your resources per time. May you not experience, in life and family, such sickness, attack or calamity that leads in the path of demonic-debt trap in the mighty name of Jesus.
confession: I’ll never be a victim. I’ll be daily guided by the Holy Spirit in the journey of life.

title: : AVOIDING DEBT TRAP
verse: aglow and burning with the Spirit, serving the Lord”
body: : AVOIDING DEBT TRAP “Never lag in zeal and in earnest endeavor; be aglow and burning with the Spirit, serving the Lord” (AMP) Rom 12:11 The word fervent means boiling. It’s metaphorically used to mean boiling with love and zeal for that which is good. You know what it takes to become fervent? Just a little extra effort! At 211o water is hot. At 212o, it boils. It's that one extra degree that makes all the difference. And you can use this great insight to reach new heights as it reflects the essential definition of excellence. That one extra degree of effort distinguishes between the good and the great. Your ability to commit yourself doggedly determines your ability to succeed. If you’ve some water on the stove and you start adding heat, it takes some minutes to take that water from room cold water to 211 degrees and it’s like much is not really happening because it has not got to the boiling point. But if you go just a little further, to 212 degrees, the water boils. That little change is due to persistence - That’s the exact spirit needed to excel.
prayer: Thank You for setting my spirit aglow. I ask for a 212 degree spirit, the spirit that never quenches until it sees things happen, Amen.

title: : THE 212 - DEGREE SPIRIT
body: : THE 212 - DEGREE SPIRIT “Bring ye all the tithes.” (KJV) Mal 3:10 Spiritual laws are as much a force in your life just like the law of gravity. They’re simple but fatedetermining - they play a major role. One of these is the law of tithing. Tithes was paid by Abraham to Melchizedek [Gen 14:20, Heb 7:2-6], Jacob vows a tenth of all his property to God [Gen 28:22], Mosaic laws support tithing [Lev 27:30-33, Num 18:21-24, Deut 12:6], A tithe of tithes is to be paid by priests [Num 18:26, Neh 10:38], Jesus supported tithe, Luke 11:42. To tithe is to return 10 percent of all we have back to God. Giving to charity is not a tithe - it’s a kind of generosity. You give tithe because tithing is an act of obedience. Tithing is acknowledging God as our only Source and Sustainer. By tithing we give God many opportunities for His goodness to flow freely through many channels to us. Tithe cuts across all we’ve received - in forms of salary, monetary gifts, bonuses, interest earned, dividends and money inherited. We own nothing. He owns everything.
prayer: Dear Father, I ask that You pardon me in every area I have ere in the past as regard tithing. I promise You to be more committed to this command in the precious name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : THE SPIRITUAL LAW OF TITHING
body: : THE SPIRITUAL LAW OF TITHING “Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named. Dorcas. full of good works and almsdeeds which she did” (KJV) Acts 9:36 Dorcas had her life reflect the magnanimity of the Master whom she served devotedly. She was a Jewess who lived among the Greeks but had become a Christian of impact. Among Dorcas’ good works was that of fashioning coats and garments for widows and the needy. The widow of Zarephath gave bread to the hungry; Martha became the queen of hospitality; Mary gave her box of fragrant ointment; Anna the prophetess gave her fastings and prayers day and night. A question came, from God, to Dorcas as it was to Moses. “What is that in thine hand?” God asked Dorcas. She said, “A needle.” She used what she had. She stitched for Christ’ people as her contributions to their lives. That made her a celebrated goddess in the city of Joppa. Use what you have. Be a Christian of impact!
prayer: Father, thank You for this depth of inspiration. I am fully persuaded I can do what You want me to do. I am also ready to use what I have where I am and see You use me beyond my widest imagination in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : BE ANOTHER DORCAS
body: : BE ANOTHER DORCAS “If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land” (KJV) Isa 1:19 “The ship that will not obey the helm will have to obey the rocks.” A man who will not be willing to obey God’s command will be willing to experience the other side of life. If a man must eat the good of the land, there must be willingness and obedience to divine instructions. Abraham’s willingness and obedience earned him the best of God [Gen 13:8-18]. Moses’ willingness and obedience granted him a place of honour in God [Num 12:3-8]. Hannah’s willingness and obedience gave her a special place among women of her time [1 sam 1:13-16]. What shall I more say about Jesus’ kind of willingness and obedience? Phil 2:3-11. A song writer says, “When we walk with the Lord in the light of His Word, What a glory He sheds on our way! While we do His good will, He abides with us still, And with all who will trust and obey. Trust and obey, for there’s no other way, To be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey.
prayer: O Lord God, I command every good of the land [mention your location and Country]. Flow in my direction, for I’ll be obedient in Jesus precious name, Amen

title: : COMMANDING THE GOOD OF THE LAND
body: : COMMANDING THE GOOD OF THE LAND “Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever” (KJV) Ps 112:3 “Riches and honour are with [God]; yea, durable riches and righteousness” (KJV) Pro 8:18. “Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning” (KJV) James 1:17. Abraham was rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold; he was greatly blessed with menservants, and maidservants, and camels and asses. [Gen 13:2 and 24:35]. And so was David who was full of days, riches, and honour [1 Chro29:28]. The man, Joseph of Arimathaea, a disciple of Jesus, was not left out. He was a man of great wealth and influence [Matt 27:57]. All these and many more were truly wealthy and walked with God. Righteousness is no hindrance to earthly riches. You can be worthy and as well as wealthy. What God did for the saints of old He can do for us. His principles work for anyone that applies them - anywhere, Ps 37:18-19.
confession: I lay claim on my divine share of earthly riches and righteousness in the name of JESUS. I reject lack and all unrighteousness. In the days of famine, I shall be satisfied.

title: : WEAL THY AND WOR THY
verse: abundantly above all that we ask or think.” (KJV)
body: : WEAL THY AND WOR THY “Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think.” (KJV) Eph 3:20 1Cor 10:13 says, “No test or temptation that comes your way is beyond the course of what others have had to face. All you need to remember is that God will never let you down; he'll never let you be pushed past your limit; he'll always be there to help you come through it” (TBCL). Thomas Edison came from a middle class parents, attended only three months of formal schooling, irritated his teacher. As a youngster he sold candy, vegetables and newspapers. Edison developed a severe deafness - almost 90% deaf. Edison was once fired at work. By 1877, he had developed the gramophone player. His inventions include, the electric light bulb, the motion picture camera, an electric car and electric power station. In 1929, he said, “None of my inventions came by accident. I see a worthwhile need to be met and I make trial after trial until it comes. What it boils down to is one per cent inspiration and ninetynine per cent perspiration.”
confession: I’m forging ahead. No force is big enough to obstruct God’s purpose for me.

title: : YOUR PRESENT CONDITION IS NO EXCUSE
verse: of the LORD it shall be seen” (KJV) Gen 22:14
body: : YOUR PRESENT CONDITION IS NO EXCUSE “And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen” (KJV) Gen 22:14 “. God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus” (ESV) Phil 4:19 is no news; it’s an undeniable biblical fact and incontestable divine reality. Jehovah-Jireh is the name immortalized by Abraham. When Isaac asked Abraham, “Where is the lamb for the burnt offering?” With great faith in God, Abraham replied, “God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son” [Gen 22:1-8; Heb 11:9]. Centuries later, King Solomon built a temple for God there [2 Chro 3:1]. Mt. Moriah is thus symbolic - it refers to a hill called Calvary, Rom 8:32. Make this prophetic declaration: And God is able to make all grace abound to me so that I always have all I need whenever I need it so I may abound to every good work - 2 Cor 9:6-9. Because I honor The Lord with my substance, with the first fruits of all my increase: as a result my barns will be filled with plenty, and my vats will overflow with new wine - Pro 3:9, 10.
prayer: I receive divine supply according to Your riches in glory in Christ Jesus, Amen - Pray through.

title: : HE IS YOUR JEHOV AH JIREH
verse: world, and lose his own soul?” (KJV) Mark 8:36
body: : HE IS YOUR JEHOV AH JIREH “What shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?” (KJV) Mark 8:36 Whenever Jesus painted the picture of hell, He was never flippant nor frivolous about it. He used dreadful and terrifying word to explain the horrors of hell [Matt 5:29-30]. Daniel referred to hell as a place of shame and everlasting contempt [Dan 12:2]. Paul spoke about it as a place of endless destruction and punishment [2 Thes 1:5-10]. Jude called it a place of eternal fire and darkness [Jud 7]. The Apostle John described hell as a place where sinners suffer everlasting torment, with no rest day or night [Rev 14:9-11]. Hell fire is a place of weeping and gnashing of teeth [Matt 8:12]; of utter destruction [Matt 10:28]; of fiery furnaces [Matt 13:42, 50]; of outer darkness [Matt 22:13]; of unquenchable fires [Mark 9:48-49] and of endless torments [Luke 16:23-24]. Make up your mind never to be a candidate of hell. Read Luke 16:1924.
prayer: Dear Father, having read Your Word, I ask that You reposition my thinking toward heaven. Cause me to always walk according to Your dictates in the precious name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : REFUSE TO LOSE YOUR SOUL
body: : REFUSE TO LOSE YOUR SOUL “Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful” (KJV) 1 Cor 4;2 Stewardship connotes a careful and good management of something entrusted to one’s care, Luke 12:42-44. It also implies using our time, talents and treasure to the glory of God. It’s an appropriate utilization of God’s gift and grace in enhancing the lives around us with the ultimate motive of pleasing God. John Wesley declares, “Do you not know that God entrusted you with that money (all above what buys necessities for your families) to feed the hungry, to clothe the naked, to help the stranger, the widow, the fatherless; and, indeed, as far as it will go, to relieve the wants of all mankind? How can you, how dare you, defraud the Lord, by applying it to any other purpose?” So, “Do all the good you can. By all the means you can. In all the ways you can. In all the places you can. At all the times you can. To all the people you can. As long as ever you can.”
confession: I commit myself more than ever before to serve God with my time and talents and with my material possession. I’ll live an accountable life on a daily basis [Repeat this severally until it’s deeply rooted in your heart].

title: : BIBLICAL STEW ARDSHIP
verse: in all things, may abound to every good work”
body: : BIBLICAL STEW ARDSHIP “And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work” (KJV) 2 Cor 9:8 The reason for every provision is for the kingdom appropriation. The more you serve with all He keeps in your custody, the more He causes you to have more than enough in all things. The more you make yourself an instrument of blessings, the more He uses you for His purposes. “So whoever cleanses himself [from what is ignoble and unclean, who separates himself from contact with contaminating and corrupting influences] will [then himself] be a vessel set apart and useful for honorable. purposes.” (Amp) 2 Tim 2:21. The more generous you become, the bigger you grow. God services you for serving others and He helps you for helping others.
prayer: The Lord who has the power to make earthly blessings come my way in abundance, I pray that You may always and under all circumstances make me self-sufficient [possessing enough to require no aid or support] and furnish me in abundance for every good work and charitable donation in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : HA VING ALL SUFFICIENCY IN ALL THINGS
body: : HA VING ALL SUFFICIENCY IN ALL THINGS “Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices.” (KJV) 1 Pet 2:5 A business man, was asked by his friend if he had met with success in his business before, his starling answer was “Met with it?” he replied; “I should say I have not. All the success I have attained I had to run after.” This is the same in all spiritual matters. A successful Christian life doesn’t just happen; you’ve to go for it and make it happen. No one becomes a saint while asleep. As God has a part to play in your spiritual growth so, you’ve a part to play, Jude 20. Take responsibility for your spiritual growth by consciously and conscientiously building up yourself. As you become more intimate in your relationship with the Holy Spirit, you are transformed from glory to glory. The more spiritually minded you become, the more the carnality gives way. “. but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.” (NKJV) Rom 8:6-8. Pleasing God is as simple as ABC - leave the realm of the flesh by yielding to the Spirit, Rom 6:13.
prayer: Father, I ask for the help of the Spirit. Let Him be my guide as I work with You and take care of my spirit being in Jesus’ name I pray, Amen.

title: : SPIRITUAL WELL BEING
body: : SPIRITUAL WELL BEING “Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through.” (ASV) Matt 6:19-20 Let’s join Judson Van De Venter (1896) to sing, “All to Jesus, I surrender; All to Him I freely give; I will ever love and trust Him, In His presence daily live. All to Jesus I surrender; Humbly at His feet I bow, Worldly pleasures all forsaken; Take me, Jesus, take me now. All to Jesus I surrender; Now I feel the sacred flame. O the joy of full salvation! Glory, glory, to His name! I surrender all, I surrender all, All to Thee, my blessed Savior, I surrender all.” The best place to save our treasures is in heaven. The matter about us is beyond here - we’re made for eternity. “Making ready for themselves a safe place for the time to come, so that the true life may be theirs” (BBE) 1 Tim 6:19. This world will soon be gone. We must not forget to keep sending there. “To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you” (KJV) 1 Pet1:4. Read Luke 12:33.
confession: With my whole heart, I promise you - to keep saving them where they are best preserved - in heaven. I surrender all - all that I have and all that I’ll have - unto You they belong.

title: : LA Y THEM UP IN HEA VEN
verse: above all the nations of the earth” (ESV) Deut 28:1
body: : LA Y THEM UP IN HEA VEN “And if you faithfully obey the voice of the LORD your God. the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth” (ESV) Deut 28:1 “You are to follow only GOD, your God, hold him in deep reverence, keep his commandments, listen obediently to what he says, serve him - hold on to him for dear life!” (TBCL) Deut 13:4. God is not moved with our tears like He is moved with our simple obedience. Noah did according to God’s commandment [Gen 6:22], Abraham obeyed God unquestionably [Gen 12:1-4], Moses and Aaron did as they were commanded [Exo 7:6], Joshua left nothing undone of all that God commanded Moses [Josh 11:15], and Zacharias walked in the commandment of God blameless [Luke 1:6]. Join the Psalmist to declare this, “Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path. I have sworn [an oath] and have confirmed it, that I will keep Your righteous ordinances [hearing, receiving, loving, and obeying them]” (Amp) Ps 119:105-106. Here comes the benefit in Pro 1:33.
prayer: Almighty God, teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness, O LORD, and I shall keep to it unto the end. For I pray in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : OBEYING THE VOICE OF GOD
verse: God loves a cheerful giver” (WEB) 1 Cor 9:7
body: : OBEYING THE VOICE OF GOD “. give. not grudgingly, or under compulsion; for God loves a cheerful giver” (WEB) 1 Cor 9:7 “But if anyone has this world's goods (resources for sustaining life) and sees his brother and fellow believer in need, yet closes his heart of compassion against him, how can the love of God live and remain in him? Little children, let us not love [merely] in theory or in speech but in deed and in truth (in practice and in sincerity)” (Amp) 1 John 3:17-18. Giving obeys God’s command, submits to divine ownership and exhibits God’s heart. The bigger the heart, the wider the hands. “For God so greatly loved and dearly prized the world that He [even] gave up His only begotten ( unique) Son, so that whoever believes in (trusts in, clings to, relies on) Him shall not perish (come to destruction, be lost) but have eternal (everlasting) life” (Amp) John 3:16. Giving expresses our faith and trust in God. Desiring God’s best? Go, practice giving that comes from and touches the heart and enjoy open heaven.
prayer: Dear Father, thanks for Your Word. [I will] be strong, therefore, and I will not let [my] hands to be weak and slack, for [my] work shall be rewarded in Jesus precious name, Amen.

title: : CHRISTIAN GIVING
body: : CHRISTIAN GIVING “Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy” (KJV) 1 Tim 6:17 In a straight forward discourse, the Psalmist wrote, “No king is saved by the multitude of an army; A mighty man is not delivered by great strength. A horse is a vain hope for safety; Neither shall it deliver any by its great strength” (NKJV) Ps 33:1617. God gives you riches that you might enjoy the richness of life and that it might be well with your soul. Besides, His intentions for granting us abundance must not be abused - our riches are meant to reach lives. God warns against highmindedness. The word high-minded is hupselophroneo in Greek meaning lofty in mind or arrogant, Pro 8:13. God commands us to hate pride. “Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed” (KJV) 1 Sam 2:3; 1 Tim 6:11-12.
confession: I’ll never be obsessed with money. My pursuit shall be after God. I commit myself to be generous. And to follow after righteousness, godliness. and lay hold on life eternal.

title: : A WORD OF W ARNING
body: : A WORD OF W ARNING “And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats.” (KJV) 1 Sam 25:2 To every door, there is the right key. Doors of blessings don’t just respond to every key; they respond to the right key. Financial freedom is not a miracle of faith but of faith-work. You’ve got to be a faith-man as well as work-man to experience financial prosperity, Jam 2:17-18. You must take responsibility to secure your financial future. We live in a consumer-driven world where we are daily compelled to spend unceasingly. Think deeply twice before making any purchase. Creating a budget and living within the same is strategic to achieving financial freedom. Another major key to financial freedom is to start plan working for yourself, rather than working for somebody. Above all, be guided by Him, Pro 4:7.
confession: I am following the path of faithwork. I am taking full responsibility for my financial freedom. According to Pro 2:11, discretion shall preserve [me], understanding shall keep [me]. I receive power - God’s unlimited power - for my financial freedom.

title: : KEY TO FINANCIAL FREEDOM
verse: the firstfruits of all your increase” (NKJV) Pro 3:9
body: : KEY TO FINANCIAL FREEDOM “Honor the LORD with your possessions, And with the firstfruits of all your increase” (NKJV) Pro 3:9 “Honor GOD with everything you own; give him the first and the best” (TBCL). It becomes imperative to honour Him - without reservation - with everything under your control. The Amplified says, “Honor the Lord with your capital and sufficiency [from righteous labors] and with the firstfruits of all your income.” The result of Pro 3:9 is what we have in verse ten of the same chapter, “So your barns will be filled with plenty, And your vats will overflow with new wine” (NKJV). The gain of giving is unquantifiable - beyond measure - It brings plenty and prosperity. “The LORD will command the blessing on you in your storehouses and in all to which you set your hand, and He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God is giving you” (NKJV) Deut 28:8. As we honour Him with our substances, he honours us by multiplying the same by geometric progression. God is not a robber. He’ll never owe any one. When you give to Him, He gives back to you, Luke 6:38.
confession: I will, via deliberate effort, honour Him with the best of my substances. I’ll give to God and others. I’ll promote His eternal cause on earth.

title: : HONOUR GOD WITH YOUR SUBST ANCES
body: : HONOUR GOD WITH YOUR SUBST ANCES “For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand. I will help thee” (KJV) Isa 41:13 “. believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper” (KJV) 2 Chro 20:20. “And the Spirit of the Lord shall rest upon [you] - the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and might, the Spirit of knowledge and of the reverential and obedient fear of the Lord - And [He] shall make [you] of quick understanding, and [your] delight shall be in the reverential and obedient fear of the Lord. And [you] shall not judge by the sight of [your] eyes, neither decide by the hearing of [your] ears” (Amp) Isa 11:2-3. As you move around establishing His eternal plans on earth: “He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night.” (KJV) Ps 91:4-13.
confession: Through God, I [your name] shall do valiantly, for He it is Who shall tread down my adversaries [Ps 60:12]. His ability is at work in me. Even though others may be weary, I shall not be weary; and I shall walk and not faint. I shall mount up with wings as eagles; I shall do great work.
